newsitem.title: CHINA: China to launch Internet service for science data.
newsitem.headline: China to launch Internet service for science data.

text.p: A Chinese scientific institute will launch soon a national computer service supplying scientific and technological information over the global Internet network, officials said on Thursday.

Wanfang Data Corp, the commercial identity of the Institute of Scientific and Technology Information of China, would provide information on scientific and technological developments in China, a company official said.
Research results, theses published in science magazines and technology documents would be available with other services including information on travel and trade, she said.
The service would be available at http://www.chinainfo.go.cn from August 6 and would initially be free, she said by telephone.
"From next February, we will collect fees from the users," she said, but gave no details.

Most services offered by Wanfang, which is controlled by the State Science and Technology Commission, would be in Chinese but the company planned to progressively increase its English-language services, the official said.
